_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Flat 30d tape, F&G ~50 and near-zero funding keep the coil intact; the accumulation-bottom analog informs what may follow later but does not justify leaving the current rung yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD/Complacency forward; narrative supplies only equity price facts with no forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound with Fear & Greed 45-55 and funding near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break that pushes Fear & Greed outside 40-60 (downside if ETF flows stay ~0 and exchange netflows elevated; upside only if flows turn positive and F&G clears 62)
